The implementation is complete and verified. Summary of what `gateway.py` implements:

**Framing & syntax validation (takes precedence over all policy):**
- CRLFCRLF body split, whole-request charset rules (printable + HTAB/CR/LF only), bare CR/LF rejection, 32768-char limit
- Continuation-line unfolding, orphan-continuation rejection, 512 physical header lines / 128 logical fields
- Compact names `f,t,i,l,c`, singleton/cardinality rules (missing/duplicate â `syntax`), repeated unknown fields discarded
- Call-ID, CSeq (range, exact method), Content-Length vs. body, Content-Type verbatim, Privacy `id|none`
- Full address grammar: token/quoted display names with escapes, angle brackets, `;tag=` with whitespace tolerance; PAI comma splitting outside quotes/brackets, 1â2 addresses with exactly one sip + one tel
- sip/tel URI grammar: user escapes decoded exactly once, DNS host labels (1â63, â¤253, optional trailing dot), no ports/params/sips, reserved anonymous URI only in From/To/request-URI

**Boundary policy:**
- `local`: subject must exist; nonanonymous From + PPI must resolve to allowed & hosted identities; selection order PPI â From â primary; PAI/RPID ignored
- `peer`: peer listed + PAI present; all PAI claims agree, identity's domain in peer authority; From/PPI/RPID must agree; anonymous From allowed
- `untrusted`, unknown subject/peer, peer without PAI â `unauthenticated`; every other failure â `identity`
- Privacy (anonymous From OR `id`), From rewrite, PAI emitted iff privacy inactive OR `trusted_out`, exact canonical wire format, `source` reuse with `upstream` propagation and recomputed trust at each hop

Verification: public check passes with byte-identical expected output, plus ~120 targeted protocol tests, 40k+ randomized malformed/valid jobs (no structural faults), fixed-point re-submission checks on ~3.5k accepted chains (0 mismatches), and a 4098-job stress batch in 0.18 s.
